column1: # - NativeBoundary runtime requirements for Rust-backed std APIs.
# - Assigns every Rust-backed std operation a capability, blocking policy,
#   cancellation policy, timeout policy, worker placement, resource policy, and
#   typed-error policy before the operation can cross the NativeBoundary.

column9: Serde JSON value operations do not carry native resources.
Base64 operations are bounded value transformations.
Path APIs transform path values and do not open files.
URI APIs parse and inspect value data only.
Cookie APIs construct and inspect typed header values.
Response APIs construct typed response values.
Session APIs operate on VM-owned session handles and typed cookie metadata.
Postgres operations use worker-owned pool and connection resources.
Vector handles are VM-tracked native resources with stale-handle checks.
